onset.Description: Time of the task switch (t = 0 of the release time vector) within the concatenated epochs

Levels.E-I: switch from external (visual search) to internal (memory) attention
Levels.I-E: switch from internal to external attention

epoch_onset.Description: Start of this epoch in the concatenated file (release time -4 s)

rejected_fraction.Description: Fraction of samples x channels of this epoch marked rejected (value 1) in D.rejected of the release; the full per-sample mask is in the original .mat under sourcedata/
